scoring_justification: Consistency of p, E0, and m*/m with the paper's implicit equation and closed-form formulas can be recomputed from the agent's CSV; the asymptotic scaling can be verified directly. No hidden gold values are required.

outputs.description: CSV file with columns: alpha (coupling constant), p (variational parameter), E0 (ground‑state energy lower bound), m_star_over_m (effective mass ratio). Must contain rows for α in {0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100}. The checker recomputes and verifies consistency and asymptotic scaling.

output_contract.notes: The task focuses strictly on the ground-state energy lower bound and effective mass; expectation values of operators (Section 4 of the paper) are excluded. The agent must implement the full numerical procedure for all required α values.
